research_notes: 2026-10-01 initial research: official parliamentary indexed biography and senator biography/first speech; contemporary Pembroke publications/exhibition;2020annualreport and governance; contemporary2021employment description.

Employment directory leads are retained for corroboration, not installed as exact career dates: UniversityofAdelaideLawSchoolmanagerJan2013–Mar2015; studentservicesMar2015–Jun2018; PembrokeAug2018–Jul2020; self-employedPrincipalConsultantSep2020onward. No public professional profile establishing these dates located. Consultant business may or may not be the earlier family business.

2018and2020Pembroke primary observations are not start/endpoints.2021and2024ICPAcontacttables still list Blyth while school annualreport names replacement; do not infer uninterrupted service from recycled directories. University2021title also needs temporal clarification.

Searched employer/university historical records, law-school role, consultant business, professional profiles and full-time statements.2017UniversityRespectNowAlwaysminutes identify LeahGrantham, not Blyth, and are excluded. MelbourneHealth/UnitingAgeWell manager and Victorian lawyer are namesakes; excluded. Staff vacancies in SenatorBlythoffice are not her own employment hours.

APH direct403 and PembrokeAutumn2020PDF400oversize are source gaps; indexedprimary evidence and alternatepublic documents recovered. No hours/leave evidence. Morethan20years does not permit a2005start calculation.
